decisions.question: V4.7 terminology patch
decisions.blocked_by: The LaTeX source of V4.7 is not available on this machine, only the PDF. The four patches are drafted with exact locations and replacement text; applying them needs the .tex.
decisions.finding: No existing use of "audit conformity" in V4.7 is incorrect. All four occurrences refer correctly to the Experiment 2 lifecycle certificate test. The patch is preventive and must land before the Experiment 1 audit text, not after.

decisions.question: For Experiment 1 only: is the protocol section 17 independent-validator requirement removed?
decisions.effect: The INDEPENDENT-REIMPLEMENTATION requirement of protocol section 17 is removed for Experiment 1. No second implementation will be produced and the gate condition independent_validator_agreement_100pc is retired as REMOVED_BY_DECISION. The REST of section 17 is untouched and still in force: the deterministic validation fixtures and the canonicalisation tests. Both still run and both still pass, 15 of 15 and 10 of 10.
decisions.declared_cost: Every audit figure now rests on a single implementation. Nothing establishes that the results are independent of the choices one implementer made when resolving contract language. This must be stated in the paper, not omitted.
what_still_supports_the_numbers: 15 of 15 deterministic fixtures agree on case status and error codes
the section 4 clean-room test reproduces all 8 outputs byte-identically with no oracle artefact present
every check carries an identifier, definition, severity, detection mode and status effect in a frozen contract
decisions.scope_precision: The question asked was specifically about a second implementation written from the frozen contracts. It was not a question about section 17 as a whole, and this record must not be read as removing the fixture requirement.

decisions.question: Who is the second coder?
decisions.answer: NO SECOND CODER. The human review layer is removed. The entire audit must be independent from human input.
decisions.effect: Protocol section 16 is REMOVED for Experiment 1. Four human-detected codes are permanently out of scope; E2_SCOPE_OVERREACH keeps only its frozen automated detector; no code in the ontology requires human judgement. The gate condition human_review_rubric_and_blinding_frozen is retired as REMOVED_BY_DECISION.
decisions.declared_scope_cost: The audit does not assess substantive citation relevance or material scope overreach beyond its frozen pattern. These are out of scope by design and must be stated as such, not reported as limitations pending work.
